1. (Currently amended) A composite stiffener, comprising: a filler disposed in and substantially filling the void; at least one layer of composite fabric on each of the members in the area of the filler; a layer of adhesive surrounding the filler and joining the filler to the composite fabric; and __wherein the composite fabric is applied as a continuous layer without wrinkles or offsets in the area of the filler__.

2. (Currently amended) The composite stiffener of claim 1, wherein the first and second members include radius areas between the web and each of the flanges, and the fabric layer covers the radius areas __and is applied without wrinkles or offsets__.

3. (Currently amended) The composite stiffener of claim 1, wherein __the filler comprises a material selected from the group consisting of: a formed unidirectional composite tape, a composite laminate, a hybrid tape-fabric member, and a titanium member__.

5. (Currently amended) The composite stiffener of claim 1, wherein the layer of adhesive and the at least one layer of composite fabric extend beyond the radius areas, and __the adhesive is applied as a continuous structural adhesive layer that is distinct from resin contained within the composite fabric__.

6. (Currently amended) The composite stiffener of claim 1, wherein the at least one layer of composite fabric of the composite members are offset relative to each other __by a predetermined spacing greater than manufacturing tolerances__.

7. (Currently amended) A composite stiffener, comprising: a pair of composite channels joined together, each of the channels including a web, flanges extending from the web, and radius areas between the web and each of the flanges; a base extending transverse to the web and joined to each of the flanges, the radius areas of the channels and the base forming at least one radius filler zone; a reinforcing member filling the radius filler zone; a layer of composite fabric covering the radius areas of the channels and the base __applied as a continuous layer without wrinkles or offsets__; and, a layer of adhesive surrounding the filler and joining the filler to the composite fabric layer __wherein the adhesive is applied as a continuous structural adhesive layer that is distinct from resin contained within the composite fabric__.

12. (Currently amended) The composite stiffener of claim 7, wherein the composite fabric layer includes __at least four composite patches__ respectively on each of the channels and the base.

13. (Currently amended) The composite stiffener of claim 7, wherein the layer of adhesive includes a sheet of structural adhesive wrapped around the filler __and wherein the structural adhesive is applied as a continuous layer distinct from resin contained within the composite fabric__.

14. (Currently amended) The composite stiffener of claim 7, wherein the layer of adhesive extends beyond the radius filler zone into interfacial layers between the channels and between the base and each of the flanges, __and wherein the adhesive in the interfacial layers is a structural adhesive distinct from resin contained within the composite fabric__.

15. (Currently amended) The composite stiffener of claim 7, wherein the channels are __formed from unidirectional composite tape plies and the base is formed from unidirectional composite tape plies, and wherein the composite fabric layer is applied without wrinkles or offsets__.

25. (Currently amended) A composite stiffener for aircraft applications, comprising: an I-section structure formed of laminated composite tape plies having a web and flanges on each end of the web, the structure including a cap and a base, the cap and base each including radius areas between the web and the flanges and intersecting the web in the radius areas to define a radius filler zone; a layer of composite fabric covering the radius areas of the I-section structure defining the radius filler zone __applied as a continuous layer without wrinkles or offsets__; a reinforcing filler in the radius filler zone; and a layer of structural adhesive surrounding the filler and joining the filler to the composite fabric in the radius filler zone, __wherein the structural adhesive is applied as a continuous layer distinct from resin contained within the composite fabric and the laminated composite tape plies__.
